## Compilation start and logging fix + debug scanner lanes

- Fixes queue attachment/startup wiring so compilation can begin consistently after enqueue.
- Re-enables crash log persistence at app launch via crash-recorder install.
- Adds explicit Low/Medium-risk pixel scanner labels in the scan profile list while keeping existing production/stable/export paths.
